summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing, as instructed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), with a docstring. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, buffering the control only when is_terminal is true and returning that result, with the required docstring note. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) using the existing wrapper method. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32) in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Choices: the console test skips on sys.platform == "win32" rather than using the Console legacy_windows flag; the renderer reuses the existing set_title wrapper. Black formatting was checked by reading line lengths only, not by running Black.
